query: Given typical industrial data sparsity, which causal-inference designs (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, instrumental variables) are practical and what data conditions do they require?

response.query: Given typical industrial data sparsity, which causal-inference designs (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, instrumental variables) are practical and what data conditions do they require?
response.answer: Difference-in-differences and synthetic controls are practical for causal inference in sparse industrial data; instrumental variables require a strong external instrument.

results.content: THE RESULTS Our new method, SemaNet, published today: → Works even with 100% missing numerical data (existing methods fail completely) → Achieves high prediction accuracy by learning from process descriptions → Reduces computational requirements by 99% through semantic filtering → Outperforms all existing LCI data completion methods Paper: "SemaNet: Bridging Words and Numbers for Predicting Missing Environmental Data in Life Cycle Assessment" on Environmental Science & Technology (https://lnkd.in/eZ2mxzpr) Published with my team: Bin Chen, Hong Chen, Zhishan Quan, Wei He, Visakan Kadirkamanathan, Jose L. Here's what makes this project unique: 🔬 Two-Stage Fine-Tuning Approach: 1️⃣ Domain Adaptation: First, the model was trained on extensive tea farming literature using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation), making it understand agricultural terminology and practices 2️⃣ Instruction Tuning: Then, supervised fine-tuning on Q&A pairs to excel at answering specific farming questions 🛠 Technical Innovation: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with LoRA adapters Progressive Training: Domain knowledge → Task-specific tuning Memory Optimization: Using 4-bit quantization and adapter merging Custom Preprocessing: Cleaned and structured agricultural text data and LLM-augmented synthetic dataset generation for data diversification 🎯 Real-World Impact: The model now provides context-aware answers to practical farming questions like: "What is the recommended spacing for tea bushes?" "How is tea plucked in Sri Lanka?" Disease diagnosis and fertilizer recommendations 🔗 Model Available on Hugging Face: Check out the trained model and try it out: https://lnkd.in/g2GXZgbn.
